producer_report.summary: A batch no longer stops as a repeated failure when the item's second failure paused its line. Root cause: Drain::attempts asked the scope guard whether the line was paused only at the top of each attempt, so the failure that caused the pause was never checked. attempts returned ItemEnd::Failed, and finish turned that into Stop::RepeatedFailure. Fix, in drain.rs: a helper `paused_reason` (the old inline lookup, now used at both places), and one re-check where the loop gives up. A paused line returns ItemEnd::Paused, so the item is passed over with one `plan <id> passed over: <pause reason>` line and the next queued item runs. Dependents of that item are held back by the existing per-wave re-plan. Unpaused items still end as Failed and stop the batch. I updated the module docs, the Stop::RepeatedFailure doc comment and Stop::meaning(). No cause classification, key masking, ATTEMPTS change, unread-rule change or scope-guard change. Tests: a Stub field `pause_on_retry` and two new tests (independent next item runs and lands; dependent item c is held back with one line). Two existing real-steps tests had to change (see mistakes). CHANGELOG.md has a Fixed entry.

open_issues: I did not read the output of the final workspace test run because it was too large. I relied on its zero exit code, and drain tests and the xtask policy test were run separately with their output read.
mistakes: The plan said existing tests would not be edited. The first full drain test run showed two real-steps tests that expected the old behavior, and I had to edit them. I changed the `rejected_twice` helper to return the report and no longer assert failed_item itself. drain_real_steps_pass_over_the_item_of_a_line_that_is_still_paused_without_reading_it now asserts failed_item None and a stop that is not RepeatedFailure. drain_real_steps_do_not_hold_an_item_for_a_stored_pause_that_no_longer_holds asserts failed_item is the job. in_flight_row_goes_when_an_item_fails_twice now uses a different criterion for the second rejection so the item still fails, as the test intends. The two named repeated-failure tests are not edited.
learnings: Two real-steps tests relied on the old behavior. A pause happens when one criterion is rejected twice. The real scope guard pauses a line on exactly the scenario this job changes, so `rejected_twice(rejecting_verdict(), rejecting_verdict())` and in_flight_row_goes_when_an_item_fails_twice now see a passed-over item, not a failed one.
Two rejections of different criteria only flag the line. They do not pause it, so such an item still fails and stops the batch.
The Stub's `paused` is asked with the item id, so a pause that begins mid-item must be keyed by the item id, not the retry job id.
desires: Bash allows only cargo, git, ls and similar commands, and Read and Grep cannot open cargo's saved large-output files. I could not search a long test log for failures and relied on the exit code.
